build_tool_start_event: build a ToolCallStart event for a hermes tool invocation with name, arguments, and generated call ID
build_tool_complete_event: build a ToolCallProgress event for a completed hermes tool call with result and function arguments
get_tool_kind_mapping: get the ACP ToolKind category for a hermes tool name like read_file or terminal
build_tool_title_string: build a human-readable title string for a tool call from its name and arguments
extract_file_locations: extract file-system locations with path and line number from tool call arguments
